title: NPM and Packages Knowledge Check
description: Check your understanding of npm, package.json, semantic versioning, scripts, lockfiles, publishing, and dependency security.
author: DailyCoder

options.text: Project metadata, scripts, dependencies, and package configuration

questions.explanation: `package.json` describes the project and how npm should manage it.

questions.prompt: Why should application repositories usually commit `package-lock.json`?

options.text: To make dependency installs more repeatable

questions.explanation: Lockfiles record exact dependency versions so installs are reproducible.

questions.prompt: In semver, what kind of change should increment the major version?
questions.explanation: Semantic versioning reserves major version changes for breaking changes.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of dependency auditing?

options.text: Identifying known vulnerabilities in dependency trees

questions.explanation: Auditing checks installed packages against vulnerability advisories.
